text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just avoiding illness. It starts with a balanced diet, which means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains while limiting processed foods and sugar. Regular exercise is equally important; even thirty minutes of walking or cycling each day can boost your energy and strengthen your heart. Do not underestimate the power of sleep, as getting seven to eight hours each night helps your body repair and your mind recover. Equally crucial is mental health, so take time to relax, practice mindfulness, or talk to someone you trust. Finally, strive for a healthy work-life balance by setting boundaries and making room for hobbies. Small, consistent choices in these areas create a strong foundation for long-term well-being.
